gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: The coach criticised the team's lack of ___ (DISCIPLINE).
gaps.explanation: 'Lack of discipline' — the noun is required after 'lack of'.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.
